title: Shared lists
description: Every list of values that more than one project writes or reads, defined once. Each item has a code (what records carry, never changed), a name (what people see) and what it covers. Adding an item is one change here.

location.title: Location from the shared list
location.description: Where a story matters: the whole world, all of India, or one Indian city.

global.description: News for every reader, wherever they are.

market_subject.title: Market subject from the shared list
market_subject.description: What a market is about. Each subject has one data slot: what it measures, and how settlement reads it. A slot names no provider; its source is chosen in PLAN.md step 1.2.

price_subject.title: Price
price_subject.description: Settlement reads the average of the valid readings measured in the 60 seconds before the market closes. If there are none, the market waits for them; if none arrive within 24 hours, it is cancelled and every bet is returned.
price_subject.$comment: Gold or oil joins this list once PLAN.md step 1.2 decides which (on hold until the founder confirms its owner).

oneOf.title: Bitcoin
oneOf.description: The price of one bitcoin in US dollars: a reference price combined from several large exchanges, so no single exchange decides a market.

ranking_subject.title: Ranking
ranking_subject.description: Settlement reads the first valid reading measured when the market closes or after: the outcome naming the model ranked first wins. If it ranks more than one model first, the market is cancelled; so it is if no reading arrives within 7 days.

oneOf.title: The best AI model
oneOf.description: A public ranking of AI models, from the source chosen in step 1.2: the models in order, with the leader first.

match_subject.title: Match
match_subject.description: Settlement reads the match's first valid reading that says finished or abandoned: the outcome for its result wins (no_result when abandoned). If the market has no outcome for that result, or no such reading arrives within 3 days of the start, it is cancelled.

oneOf.title: Cricket
oneOf.description: Professional cricket matches: who plays, the live score, and the result.

oneOf.title: Football
oneOf.description: Professional football matches: who plays, the live score, and the result.
